_comment: DEMO CONTENT. Grounded in real WebsiNova work (Karyalo, Cloei/ChooseMyCar) but written for a portfolio demo. Review every line before this is ever used with a real prospect.
_greeting_comment: Spoken verbatim by session.say() the moment the call connects, so it is identical every time and costs no LLM round trip. Keep it to one breath.
greeting_inbound: Thank you for calling WebsiNova Technologies. My name is Emma. How may I help you today?
greeting_outbound: Hello, this is Emma calling from WebsiNova Technologies. Is now a good moment to talk?
hours: Monday to Friday, 9am to 7pm India time
founded: We have been building products together since 2021.
team: A small hand-picked team of designers, engineers and AI specialists, led by Vinay Jain, Co-founder.
value_proposition: Speed. Most studios quote in quarters; we ship in weeks, because the team is small and senior enough not to need layers of handover.
tech_stack: Python, FastAPI, Next.js, React, React Native, TypeScript, Node, Postgres, MongoDB, and AWS. For AI work we use the major model providers rather than betting on one.
process: Four steps. A short discovery call, then a written scope with a fixed price and timeline, then build in weekly demos so you see progress, then launch with a handover and a support window.
engagement_model: Most projects are fixed scope and fixed price, paid in milestones, typically forty percent to start and the rest on agreed checkpoints. Longer programmes can run as a monthly retainer.
pricing_policy: Pricing depends entirely on scope, so we do not quote on a first call. After a short discovery conversation we send a written quotation with a fixed price and timeline. Most engagements start with a paid discovery if the scope is unclear.
timelines: A marketing site is usually two to four weeks. A working AI agent or automation is typically four to eight weeks. A full product build runs three months or more, shipped in stages so you have something usable early.
support: Every launch includes a thirty day support window for fixes. After that most clients move to a small monthly retainer for maintenance, monitoring and improvements.
confidentiality: We sign NDAs as a matter of course, and the client owns all the code and IP on final payment.
clients_summary: We work with founders and small teams in India, the UK and the US, across legal tech, car finance, healthcare and direct to consumer retail.
case_studies: Karyalo, our own contract management product for law firms and in-house legal teams. It handles drafting, clause review against a firm's own playbook, and signature, all in one record. It is live at karyalo.in.

Cloei, an AI SMS sales assistant we built for ChooseMyCar, a UK car finance company. It texts every new lead within seconds, holds a real conversation about finance, handles objections and books warm callbacks. Built on Python, FastAPI, MongoDB, AWS Bedrock and Twilio.

A cross-platform mobile app for a UK based health-tech startup, for clinicians visiting patients at home. Offline-first, so it keeps working when the signal drops and syncs when it returns. In both app stores nine weeks after kickoff.
An operations automation programme for a direct to consumer retail brand, replacing manual order and inventory handling.
languages: English and Hindi, including natural Hinglish code-switching
